subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 10 Once there was a small boy named Bayazid. His mother was ill. One night he was studying by the side of the bed of his mother. All on a sudden, his mother woke up, raised her head and told her son to give her a glass of water........ 10 The chart below shows the benefits of girls' education. Describe the chart in 150 words. You should highlight and summarise the information given in the chart. 10 Girls' Education Improved Reduced Increased Sustained health and population economic development nutrition growth productivity efforts
